content.text:
Any engineer on the Growth team can approve it. Post the change in **#growth-eng** for sign-off.

The Growth team has owned the notifier since 2026-09-01. Before that, Dana Okafor owned it and had to approve copy changes herself. She has since moved to Platform, so she's no longer the approver.

This comes from the project's shared memory notes. The repo has no CODEOWNERS file to confirm it. An older note still named Dana as the approver, and I've flagged it as outdated so it stops coming up.

When you make the edit, the receipt template is in `services/notifier/templates/` as an `.mjml` file. It has a plain-text `.txt` version next to it, which needs the same wording change. Some corporate mail gateways strip HTML, so those readers only see the plain-text version.
